'''House Killesa''' was a minor [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] noble house, vassal to the [[House of Thul]], that was led by Lord [[Cedarik Killesa]] at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
